tasks.title: Scaffold the workspace
tasks.description: Set up the Cargo workspace with the initial crate layout, .gitignore, and CI configuration.
tasks.done_when: cargo build passes from the workspace root and CI is green.

tasks.title: Task and task-graph types
tasks.description: Define the Rust domain types for Task, TaskId, TaskState, and TaskGraph with full serde support. Timestamps use chrono RFC3339. Optional fields use skip_serializing_if.
tasks.done_when: A sample task graph round-trips through serde_json serialize/deserialize and TaskGraph::validate() returns Ok.

tasks.title: Runtime artifact schema doc and sample
tasks.description: Document the .tasks/{slug}.json JSON schema, produce a canonical sample artifact, and add a validation integration test.
tasks.done_when: The schema is documented at docs/spec/runtime-artifact-schema.md, a sample artifact exists at docs/spec/examples/sample-run.tasks.json, and an integration test loads the sample, deserializes it into TaskGraph, and asserts validate() is Ok.

tasks.title: Planner actor
tasks.description: Implement the Planner kameo actor that reads a structured-text task list, infers dependency edges, and writes the initial .tasks/{slug}.json artifact.
tasks.done_when: Given a well-formed TASKS.md, the Planner actor produces a valid .tasks/{slug}.json that passes TaskGraph::validate().
